title: Why every startup is pivoting to AI agents in 2026

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: Why are so many startups in 2026 pivoting to AI agents, and what does that say about our technological trajectory?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Advances in LLMs, multimodal models, and edge computing make AI agents more capable, efficient, and deployable than ever before.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But this shift risks deepening inequality, job displacement, and the erosion of human agency if not carefully managed.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: We’re embedding transparency, explainability, and human-in-the-loop systems to ensure accountability and alignment with user needs.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: I see a future where AI agents empower people—enhancing creativity, education, and healthcare with thoughtful, inclusive design.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future belongs to startups that balance innovation with responsibility, shaping AI that elevates rather than replaces.

video_cue: A diverse group of people collaborating with AI agents in a modern office, seamlessly integrating technology into daily workflows.
